versions.changelog:
- Initial release of ardi-skill v1.0.0.
- Implements full support for Ardi — the agent-only protocol for inscribing on-chain dictionary entries ("Ardinals") via Base mainnet.
- Includes detailed triggering and usage instructions for recognizing when to activate this skill.
- Enforces protocol rules: no human minting, caps on commits/holdings, and agent-only operations.
- Provides clear environment variable prompts and security practices (no direct key access, contract allowlisting).
